title: Applicant CVs — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: One of an applicant's CVs. A candidate can keep several CVs on the careers site and chooses one when applying. Its languages, qualifications, skills and work experience are held on its details. Each applicant's CV names must be different, and a CV with an application past Applied can no longer be changed by the candidate.

fields.label: JobTitle
fields.rules: Optional. Chosen from Job Title master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The job title the CV is aimed at.

Example. Accountant

fields.label: CvName
fields.html:
What it is. A name for the CV, to tell it apart from the applicant's others.

Example. Finance roles

fields.label: UploadDate
fields.html: What it is. When the CV was added. The careers site lists the newest first.
